purpose: Pre-run registration for the N3 rule arm (plan v2, review notes 1-3): pins the program, its executed dependencies, scope inputs, gold pin, judges and boundary behaviours. Archive hashes are recorded separately in n3-rulearm-delivery.md; this file stays byte-identical after runs.

run_n3_arm.role: gate functions: check_items_binding / check_metric_tool / selected_facts_of / classify_plan / load_jsonl

d2_metrics.role: scoring, shape checks, check_gold_sha, differential reference build_gold_row

n3_plan.role: indirect dependency of d2_metrics (check_invariants); structural verdicts depend on it

passLine.reference: frozen record passLine, scope 8-item only; 16-item diagnostic-only

boundaryBehaviours: ill-formed (unknown kind / missing-duplicate factId / non-string goal): refuse generation
unsupported time-orphan (leading time, no entity fact): refuse official plan, reason archived
unsupported no-entity: refuse official plan (empty plan would drop selected facts)
consecutive time: exploration probe T-P7 only, never part of the frozen gate
same name different entityIds: separate groups, identical mentions allowed (rendering ambiguity = N4-coref, unverified)
n4Boundary: groups with more than 4 facts are marked n4_out_of_range and listed; no splitting, no fallback (coordinator ruling)
archiveHashes: recorded post-run in n3-rulearm-delivery.md; not in this file
